mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 7.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate hiring costs and inflationary pressure, leading to higher equity risk premiums and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 7.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, reducing forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, which increases corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals robust economic expansion, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 150k in a single month signals strong labor demand, which raises inflation expectations and triggers preemptive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS > 150, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate indicates persistent inflationary pressure without policy response, which increases real interest rate uncertainty and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 233.0 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong underlying demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 5-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
